title: RxNorm Current Prescribable Content Monthly Release
versionLabel: Current Prescribable Content monthly release, July 6, 2026
citation: U.S. National Library of Medicine. RxNorm Current Prescribable Content Monthly Release. July 6, 2026.
populations: Not population-specific; normalized identities for currently prescribable U.S. drug concepts

accessPolicy.licenseLabel: U.S. government public-domain RxNorm normalized names and codes; no license required for the Current Prescribable Content subset
accessPolicy.note: NLM states that RxNorm normalized names and codes are U.S. government public-domain data and that the Current Prescribable Content subset can be downloaded without a UMLS license. PsychSim must use the named no-license subset, retain exact release identity, exclude data from the full release's proprietary source vocabularies, acknowledge NLM, avoid endorsement implications, and keep identity normalization separate from clinical claims.
